commitResults.messageTitle: Add exception classes, and error handling from erroneous user input
Add save feature and error handling for it
Add dates and times to the command
Extract Ui, Storage, Parser, and TaskList from Axiom
commitResults.messageBody:
Separate concerns so Axiom acts as a thin orchestrator rather than
handling user I/O, command parsing, task-list management, and file
persistence in one class.

- Add Ui for all user-facing input and output (banner, messages, errors)
- Add Parser to interpret commands and build Task objects from user input
- Add TaskList to encapsulate add/delete/mark operations on the task list
- Refactor Storage from static helpers to an instance class that takes a
  file path and saves/loads via TaskList
- Slim Axiom down to constructor + run(), delegating to the new classes
  while preserving existing behaviour (all 21 UI tests still pass)

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Move all Java sources from the default package into a proper package
hierarchy under src/main/java, keeping that folder as the source root.

Package layout:
- axiom: Axiom entry point and AxiomException
- axiom.command: Command enum
- axiom.parser: Parser and DateTimeParser
- axiom.storage: Storage
- axiom.task: Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, TaskList
- axiom.ui: Ui

Add getters on Task subclasses so Storage can serialize tasks across
package boundaries without relying on protected fields. Update the test
run command and README to use src/main/java/axiom/Axiom.java.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

and seedu-git-standard for commits.

method header comments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command to search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot locate tasks in a long list without scanning every entry
manually.

Let's add a find command that matches keywords case-insensitively against
task descriptions and displays results with their original list numbers.
Includes JUnit and UI test coverage.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
